title: Creating a name another user just created is refused, window stays
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Two Admins work at once and both create a new term with the same name.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S3 Second Admin.
  • A new name {Term-A} that no term has.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-25 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page is open in both browsers.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click "New Credit Term".
  2. In your browser, type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. In your browser, type 14 in the Days box.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click "New Credit Term".
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, type {Term-A} in Name.
  6. In {User-B}'s browser, type 20 in the Days box.
  7. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Create Credit Term".
  8. In your browser, click "Create Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: {User-B}'s window opens.
  • Step 5: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 6: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 7: {User-B} sees "{Term-A} created".
  • Step 8: the app's error alert shows "A term called {Term-A} already exists." Your window stays open with {Term-A} and 14 still typed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-E2: “If another user creates a term with the same name while the window is open, Create is refused with "A term called {name} already exists." and the window stays open.”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If Create or Save is refused by the server, the app's standard error alert shows the reason (the S3-R9 texts, or "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." when no option is sent, or "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." when the term became in use meanwhile). The window stays open with the user's input.”
